## Suggestion type

- [ ] Standard Track (changes to the Touchstone Standard)
- [ ] Library Track (changes to the `clarethium-touchstone` library that conform to the Standard)
- [ ] Process Track (changes to project processes or governance)
- [ ] Informational (best practices, integration guides)

See `SUGGESTIONS/PROCESS.md` for the full process.

## Summary

One paragraph describing the proposed change.

## Motivation

Why this change matters. What problem does it solve?

## Proposed change

Specific, concrete description of what changes:

- For Standard Track: which sections of the Standard are affected, what the new wording should be
- For Library Track: what API or behavior changes, what tests are affected
- For Process Track: what process changes, why
- For Informational: what document or guide is being added

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is this proposal better?

## Backwards compatibility

Does this change break existing implementations or users? If yes, what is the migration path?

For Standard Track, indicate whether this is:

- [ ] Major version bump (breaking)
- [ ] Minor version bump (additive)
- [ ] Patch version bump (editorial)

## Implementation notes

If you've thought about implementation, sketch it here. For Standard Track suggestions, include a sketch of how the Standard would be implemented in code.

## Reference test cases

For Standard Track suggestions, propose reference test cases that would verify the change. Reference cases ship with the Standard version that incorporates the change.

## References

Related issues, prior discussions, external work, citations.
